newsitem.title: FINLAND: PARTEK - SISU TRACTORS TO BE MADE IN INDIA.
newsitem.headline: PARTEK - SISU TRACTORS TO BE MADE IN INDIA.

text.p: Finnish building materials and cargo handling equipment group Partek Oy Ab said on Monday Indian Eicher Tractors would buy a license to start making Sisu's Valmet 365 model tractors in India.

"Sisu Tractors, which is part of the Partek Group, has today made an agreement with the Indian Eicher Tractors Ltd for the manufacture of tractors under license. Eicher Tractors will purchase the manufacturing license for the Valmet 365 tractor and start producing it in India," Partek said in a statement.
The first tractors would be ready in 2-3 years when output would be 1,000 tractors per year, it said.
"The aim is to increase the production up to about 5,000 tractors a year, depending on the market situation," it added.
Demand for tractors would increasing in India as agriculture should be mechanised to improve productivity, Partek said.

"The licensing agreement will strengthen the position of Valmet tractors among the leading tractor producers and improve competitiveness, because it will make it possible to sell less expensive ... tractors in India and in the neighbouring countries," it added.
Partek said the strategy of its Sisu Tractors unit was to focus on the European and South-American markets and seek partnerships elsewhere.
Sisu Tractors is the sixth-biggest tractor producer in Europe. Net sales in 1996 totalled 2.6 billion markka. The company has tractor plants in Finland and Brazil, Partek said .
Eicher Tractors is a leading tractor producers in India with two tractor plants, an engine plant and a product development centre. The Eicher Groups net sales were about one billion markka last year.
